how.title: Join, predict, compare, win
how.intro: A World Cup pool with friends — no spreadsheets, no WhatsApp groups full of screenshots: the app saves your predictions, scores the points in real time and shows the leaderboard at every moment of the tournament.
how.step1Text: Create your private pool and share the 4-digit code, or join with your friends' code.
how.step2Text: Depending on your pool's mode: in Full, group standings, FIFA bracket, Golden Boot and the score + scorer of each match; in Score, just the scoreline; in Winner Only, just the winner.
how.step3Text: As the matches are played, points are added instantly. The leaderboard updates live.
how.step4Text: Whoever reads the tournament best wins. Bragging rights, a symbolic league trophy, or whatever the players agree on.

modes.title: Choose how deep you want to go

faqs.a1: You join a pool (the public one or a private one with a 4-digit code) and predict according to its game mode. In Full mode: the standings of the 12 groups, the full bracket, the scorers, the score of each match and special predictions. In Score: just the exact score of each match. In Winner Only: just who wins each match. You earn points as you get them right, with overall and per-league leaderboards.
faqs.a2: Three, and you choose whichever you like when you create your pool (each mode also has its own public pool). Full: the entire experience — group standings, FIFA bracket, Golden Boot, specials and score + scorer of each match. Score: just the exact score of each match, simple and direct. Winner Only: just who wins each match (or a draw), the fastest to fill in, ideal for large groups or people with little time.
faqs.q3: Is it free to make a pool?
faqs.a3: Yes, up to 20 members per private pool. You can create up to 5 private pools for free with your friends and always take part in the Public Pool. For companies or larger groups (50, 100 or 250 members), we have 2026 World Cup Passes from €19 — see /precios.
faqs.q4: Are there plans for companies and large groups?
faqs.a4: Yes. The Standard version supports up to 20 members per pool, for free. For companies, communities or events with more people there are 2026 World Cup Passes that scale the league to 50, 100 or 250 members. One payment per tournament. Details at /precios.
faqs.q5: Is there an app for iPhone and Android?
faqs.a5: It works as a Progressive Web App: from Safari (iPhone/iPad) or Chrome (Android) you can 'Add to Home Screen' and it behaves like a native app, full screen and with its own icon.
faqs.q6: When and where is the 2026 World Cup played?
faqs.a6: From June 11 to July 19, 2026 in the United States, Canada and Mexico. It's the first edition with 48 teams, 12 groups, 104 matches and 16 venues across the three host countries.
faqs.q7: How do I join my friends' pool?
faqs.a7: Ask the creator for the 4-digit code or the invite link. Enter it on the join screen and you're in instantly. Each user can belong to the public pool plus 5 private pools.
faqs.q8: Can I change my prediction afterwards?
faqs.a8: Yes, as long as the matchday or stage hasn't closed. Each category has its deadline (the group stage closes at the kickoff of the matchday's first match; scores close at the start of each match).
faqs.q9: Who runs the tournament and publishes the matches?
faqs.a9: The 2026 World Cup is organized by FIFA. This site is not affiliated — it's just a predictions tool. All schedule, group and venue information reflects the official programming published by FIFA.
faqs.q10: How many private pools can I create or join?
faqs.a10: Up to 5 private pools per user, plus the Public Pool (always active). You can be the creator of some and just a participant in others; each with its own leaderboard.

about.title: The collaborative 2026 World Cup pool
about.p1: Quiniela Mundial 2026 is the platform to play your 2026 World Cup pool with your group. You choose whether to compete with the community in the Public Pool or to create a private one with your friends, your team or your whole company. You predict scores, scorers, group standings, the bracket and a handful of special questions — all in the same app, with no spreadsheets or WhatsApp groups full of screenshots.
about.p2: Whether it's the office pool, the sweepstake with friends or the bracket with your mates, Quiniela Mundial 2026 works the same: one product, you choose the name — the collaborative experience and the points mechanics, identical.
about.p3: Creating a pool on <home>Quiniela Mundial 2026</home> is free up to 20 members. For companies, communities or events with large groups there are <pricing>2026 World Cup Passes</pricing> from €19 (one payment, no subscription) that scale the league up to 50, 100 or 250 members with corporate logo, pinned announcement and CSV export.

faqPage.headerDesc: What people ask us most about accounts, pools, predictions and the tournament. If you can't find your answer, write to us.

s1.title: How the pool works
s1.q1: Is a World Cup pool the same as a sweepstake, a bracket or an office pool?
s1.a1: Yes — they're different names for the same thing depending on the country (porra in Spain, prode in Argentina, pool in the US, sweepstake or bracket in English). It's what we offer here: a 2026 World Cup pool where you and your group predict the results (score, scorers, standings, bracket) and rack up points. Whatever your league calls it, the app works exactly the same.
s1.a2: You join a pool (the public one or a private one with a 4-digit code) and predict according to its game mode: Full (group standings, bracket, scorers, match-by-match scores and specials), Score (just the exact score of each match) or Winner Only (just who wins). You earn points as you get them right. There are overall and per-league leaderboards, live during the tournament.
s1.q3: Is it free to make a pool?
s1.a3: Yes, up to 20 members per private pool. You can create up to 5 private pools for free with your friends and always take part in the Public Pool. For companies or larger groups (50, 100 or 250 members), we have 2026 World Cup Passes from €19 — see /precios.
s1.q4: Do you have plans for companies or large groups?
s1.a4: Yes. The Standard version supports up to 20 members per pool, for free. For companies, communities or events with more people there are three 2026 World Cup Passes (€19 up to 50 members · €49 up to 100 · €99 up to 250) that include a custom corporate logo, a pinned organizer announcement, CSV export of the leaderboard and priority support. One payment per tournament. More at /precios.
s1.q5: Is there an app for iPhone and Android?
s1.a5: It works as a Progressive Web App: from Safari (iPhone/iPad) or Chrome (Android) you can 'Add to Home Screen' and it behaves like a native app, full screen and with its own icon.
s1.a6: The 2026 World Cup is organized by FIFA. This site is not affiliated with FIFA — it's just a predictions tool. All schedule, group and venue information reflects the official programming published by FIFA.

s2.title: Accounts and privacy
s2.a1: With Google only. You click 'Create pool' or 'Log in', authorize with your Google account and you're straight in. No email form or password to remember.
s2.a2: Your email, name, avatar (the ones Google returns), your predictions, your chat messages and the points you earn. Nothing else.
s2.a3: Yes. From My Profile you can request deletion or, if you prefer, write to admin@quinielamundial.es and we process it manually.

s3.title: Private pools
s3.q1: How do I create my private pool?
s3.a1: After logging in we take you to onboarding. You choose 'Create pool', name it (max 25 characters), pick the prediction mode (Full, Score or Winner Only) and the plan, and the app generates a 4-digit code and an invite link, both fixed forever.
s3.q2: How do I join my friends' pool?
s3.a2: Ask the creator for the 4-digit code or the invite link. Enter it on the join screen and you're in instantly.
s3.q3: How many private pools can I have?
s3.a3: Up to 5 private pools per user, plus the Public Pool (always active). You can be the creator of some and a participant in others; each with its own leaderboard.
s3.q4: How many members fit in my private pool?
s3.a4: Up to 20 members on the Free plan. If your group grows (company, community, event), you can expand it to 50, 100 or 250 members with a 2026 World Cup Pass — you don't migrate data, the limit just goes up in the same league. Details and prices at /precios.
s3.q5: Can I remove someone from my pool?
s3.a5: Yes, if you're the creator. From 'My pool' you have a button to remove members and another to delete the whole pool (everyone moves to the public one).
s3.q6: Can I leave a pool I'm in?
s3.a6: Yes, from 'My pool'. The public one is the only exception — it's permanent. After leaving a private pool, the public one becomes active again.

s4.title: Predictions and points
s4.q1: Which prediction modes can I choose?
s4.a1: Three, which you choose when you create your pool (each mode also has its own public pool and its own leaderboard). Full: the entire experience — group standings, FIFA bracket, Golden Boot, special predictions and score + scorer of each match. Score: just the exact score of each match, simple and direct. Winner Only: just who wins each match (or a draw), the fastest to fill in — ideal for large groups or people with little time. In Score and Winner Only there are no groups, bracket, Golden Boot or specials.
s4.q2: What are the categories in Full mode?
s4.a2: In Full mode there are six: group standings, full FIFA bracket, tournament top scorer (Golden Boot), match-by-match scores, scorer per match and special predictions (questions like 'will there be penalties in the quarters?'). The Score and Winner Only modes use only the prediction of each match.
s4.q3: Until when can I change my prediction?
s4.a3: Each category has its deadline. Group standings and the Golden Boot close at the tournament kickoff. Each match closes at the start of that match. The bracket closes at the first round-of-32 match. Specials have their own date (always before the moment being predicted).
s4.a4: Each category has its own rubric. For example: in scores you earn more points for an exact score than for just the winner; in scorer per match you score if your player scores; in groups you score for each correct position. You have the full breakdown and the exact points at /puntuacion, and you'll also see them on each prediction screen.
s4.q5: Can I see other people's predictions?
s4.a5: Yes, but they only become public once they can no longer be changed. Once a match starts (or the stage closes), the whole league's predictions become visible to everyone. Before that they're locked.
s4.q6: What happens if I don't predict a match?
s4.a6: You're left with zero points for that match. The app warns you with a banner when a matchday is about to close and you still have matches left to predict.

s5.title: About the 2026 World Cup
s5.q1: When and where is it played?
s5.a1: From June 11 to July 19, 2026 in the United States, Canada and Mexico. It's the first edition with 48 teams, 12 groups, 104 matches and 16 venues across the three host countries.
s5.a2: It changes from previous editions: 12 groups of 4 teams, the top 2 + the 8 best third-placed sides advance to a new round of 32. Then round of 16, quarters, semis and the final on July 19 in New York-NJ.
s5.a3: MetLife Stadium, New York-NJ. The opening match is on June 11 at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City.

pricing.headerDesc: The Standard version handles up to 20 members for free. For companies, communities and events with more people, the 2026 World Cup Passes scale the league to 50, 100 or 250 people with extras designed for professional use.
pricing.feat1: Internal departments with a points-average ranking
pricing.featuresTitle: Same package in all three plans
pricing.featuresDesc: The three Passes include exactly the same benefits — the only thing that changes between them is your pool's member cap.
pricing.entDesc: Custom quote for large groups, assisted onboarding, extended branding and dedicated support throughout the tournament.

faq.a1: Click Buy on the plan you want, the Paddle checkout opens (card or PayPal) and when you confirm the payment we're notified instantly. As soon as we verify you're linked to the right pool, we raise the member cap — usually right away.
faq.q2: Can you issue an invoice with my company details?
faq.a2: Yes. Payment is processed by Paddle as Merchant of Record: they issue a legal invoice with the applicable VAT (in Spain, 21%; in other EU countries, the applicable rate). During checkout you can enter your company's tax details and the invoice downloads instantly as a PDF — valid for accounting deduction.
faq.q3: Is the price per tournament or a subscription?
faq.a3: One-time payment: the 2026 World Cup Pass covers the whole edition — from June 11 to July 19, 2026. No subscription or automatic renewals.
faq.q4: We need more than 250 members, what do we do?
faq.a4: Tell us the actual figure in the form message and we'll send you a custom quote.
faq.a5: Any 2026 World Cup Pass (50, 100 or 250) unlocks internal departments. You create sub-groups (Marketing, Sales, Engineering…) and assign each member to theirs. They compete on points AVERAGE, not totals — so a small department can beat a big one. There's a separate ranking in /ranking → Departments.
faq.q6: What if I want to try it before paying?
faq.a6: Create a free pool up to 20 members to show the team. When you're convinced, buy the Pass from /precios and we raise the limit without migrating data — same league, same members, more capacity.
faq.a7: If the tournament hasn't started yet and you're not happy with the tool, write to us: we handle the refund with Paddle. Once the World Cup has begun, the refund no longer applies as the service has been consumed.

scoringPage.gruposTagline: Rank the 4 teams in each of the 12 groups from 1st to 4th. Locks at the tournament kickoff.
scoringPage.bracketTagline: Predict who advances round by round — from the round of 32 to the final. Locks when the group stage ends.
